newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money rates steady in balanced trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money rates steady in balanced trade.

text.p: Demand for kuna funds was met in full as morning trade picked up on the Croatian money market on Monday.
"In today's morning trade we have experienced the funds on offer covering the entire demand," a dealer said.
Fresh borrowings accounted for 29.7 million, mostly call money at a steady 11 percent, she said.
Two smaller short-term loans were granted at 16 percent.
The weekend overnight trade totalled 28.5 milion kuna as 3 banks with shortfalls borrowed money to square their positions.
